# Mubifiles

> Browser-based tool for moving text and files between two devices. One device
> starts a session and gets a 6-digit code; the other enters that code and the
> two are paired. No account, no install, and the devices do not need to be on
> the same network.

Files are stored server-side for the duration of a session, so the sender and
receiver do not have to be online at the same time. A session closes after
about 15 minutes of inactivity, with a 24-hour hard limit, and its files are
deleted when it closes. Limits are 100 MB per file and 500 MB per session.
An optional one-time-download mode deletes a file after a single fetch.

## Pages

- [Mubifiles](https://www.mubifiles.com/): The app itself, plus how it works and
  answers to common questions about accounts, expiry, code security and size
  limits.
- [Snapdrop alternatives](https://www.mubifiles.com/snapdrop-alternative/):
  What happened to snapdrop.net after the domain was sold, and a comparison of
  PairDrop, LocalSend, Quick Share and Mubifiles, including the cases where
  Mubifiles is the wrong choice.
- [Sending files between devices on different networks](https://www.mubifiles.com/send-files-between-different-networks/):
  Why most browser transfer tools require both devices on one Wi-Fi, what client
  isolation is, and which tools work when the devices are on separate networks.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://www.mubifiles.com/privacy/): What is stored, for how long, and
  what is not collected. No accounts, no analytics, no cookies. Sub-processors are
  Vercel and Cloudflare.
- [Terms of use](https://www.mubifiles.com/terms/): Provided as-is with no
  guaranteed availability; users are responsible for what they send.
- [Report abuse](https://www.mubifiles.com/report/): How to report content, and
  why we cannot identify who uploaded it.

## Notes

- Mubifiles relays files through storage rather than connecting devices
  peer-to-peer. For transfers on a single local network, LocalSend is faster.
  For large files, PairDrop imposes no hard size limit where Mubifiles caps at
  100 MB.
- Session URLs take the form https://www.mubifiles.com/?code=123456 and are
  served with X-Robots-Tag: noindex. They are short-lived and not useful to
  index or link to.
